race.description: Karratha Fluid Power Powering The Pilbara Hcp (56+)
race.comment: RENOVATION SHOW (2) settled well back last start and never threatened when eighth over 1600m at Port Hedland. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot find winning ways again despite a couple of poor efforts recently. OSCAR WINNER (1) has scored at his last two starts, most recently by a nose over 1600m at Port Hedland. That continued the good form this campaign, with three wins from six runs. Sure to go well again. MY DE GRECE (11) ran below expectations last time at Port Hedland, finishing fifth after starting at $7.50. Looks well placed so expect a big run this time. HUNDRED YARDS (3) raced on the speed last start and battled on well but found one better over 1600m at Carnarvon. Expected to be in the finish. HOLDOUT (7) is racing in good order and can't be left out of calculations.
